item.title: Bulletin updated at 04:50 HKT 07/Aug/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
With the southwest monsoon moderating and upper-air disturbances weakening, showers will ease off over the coast of Guangdong today. An anticyclone aloft will bring mainly fine and very hot weather to southern China in the latter part of this week to early next week. With the anticyclone aloft shifting northwards from the coast of southern China, showers will increase gradually over the region in the middle and latter parts of next week. Besides, an area of low pressure now near Luzon will move across the region today, then enter the South China Sea and its intensity will remain relatively weak. It will bring unsettled weather to the central and northern parts of the South China Sea.
